title: Homepage Hero Carousel Functionality
description: Verify the homepage hero carousel loads images correctly, autoplays, loops, and no broken text appears.

steps.description: Navigate to the homepage
Check that hero images load fully without broken links
Verify the carousel autoplays and transitions smoothly between slides
Ensure that hero text is displayed correctly on all slides without truncation or layout issues
Manually navigate carousel slides using controls
Confirm slides switch correctly on manual input and loop back to first after last slide

title: Responsive Navigation Menu Behavior
description: Verify desktop and mobile navigation menus including hamburger toggle, dropdowns, and accessible states.

steps.description: Open the site on desktop viewport
Validate main navigation links are visible, correct, and clickable
Test dropdown menus appear on hover and contain correct links
Resize viewport to mobile width
Check hamburger menu icon is visible and main navigation links are hidden initially
Click hamburger menu to open navigation drawer
Verify navigation links appear and dropdown menus expand/collapse on tap
Use keyboard to navigate menu for accessibility testing
Ensure keyboard focus states and tab order are logical
Close navigation drawer
Confirm the menu is hidden and return to page content

title: Public Product Listings and Details Navigation
description: Validate product listings segmented by Bespoke and Modular categories and navigation to detailed product pages.

steps.description: Navigate to public products main page
Verify listing shows categorized sections for Bespoke and Modular
Click on Bespoke category link to view Bespoke products
Check Bespoke product list loads with product names and thumbnails
Click on a Bespoke product to open its details page
Verify product details load correctly based on route parameter
Ensure images lazy load as user scrolls without layout jumps
Navigate back to Bespoke product list
Repeat steps for Modular category products
Confirm smooth navigation between listings and detail pages without errors

title: Solutions and Solution Subpages Content Display
description: Check Solutions page loads with minimal layout shifts and displays detailed subpages with optimized images.

steps.description: Navigate to the Solutions main page
Verify the solution listing displays all solution items accurately
Click a solution to navigate to its detailed solution subpage
Check that the detailed solution subpage content loads fully without layout jumping
Ensure images on the solution page are optimized and lazy loaded

title: Support Section FAQ and Form Validation
description: Validate FAQ displays properly and support form enforces robust validation with error handling and success toasts.

steps.description: Navigate to the Support page
Verify the FAQ section displays all questions and answers correctly
Attempt to submit the support inquiry form with empty mandatory fields
Check that form validation errors are displayed for required fields
Submit the form with invalid inputs (e.g., wrong email format)
Confirm validation error messages for incorrect input formats appear
Submit form with valid data
Verify a success toast is displayed confirming submission
Simulate backend API failure during form submission
Confirm user sees an appropriate error message and can retry submitting

title: Admin Authentication: Login and Session Management
description: Test admin login page handles valid and invalid credentials correctly and protects admin routes with session management.

steps.description: Navigate to the admin login page
Enter invalid username/email and password
Click login button
Verify that an error message is shown and login is rejected
Enter valid credentials and submit
Confirm successful login and redirect to admin dashboard
Try to access protected admin routes without logging in
Ensure access is denied and redirected to login page
Logout from admin dashboard
Verify session is cleared and admin routes become inaccessible

title: Admin Product Management: Add, Edit, List Products
description: Verify admin can list existing products, add new products with validation, and edit product details with updates reflecting on public site.

steps.description: Login to admin dashboard
Navigate to product management page
Check that list of products is displayed with correct details
Click add new product button
Attempt to submit product form with missing required fields
Confirm form validation errors are shown
Fill all required fields correctly and submit new product
Verify product is added and visible in admin list
Navigate to edit existing product page
Modify product details and save
Check changes persist in admin list and are reflected on public product details page

title: Content Management System (CMS) Updates Reflect on Public Site
description: Validate that changes made in admin CMS for homepage, solutions, and support content update the public facing pages immediately.

steps.description: Login to admin dashboard
Update homepage main content and save
Verify updated content is visible on public homepage without errors
Edit solution pages content via CMS and publish changes
Check solution pages on public site reflect new content
Modify support FAQ content in admin CMS and save
Confirm updated FAQ content appears on public support page

title: Inquiry Management and Real-time Updates in Admin Dashboard
description: Test admin inquiry management section shows incoming customer inquiries in real-time and supports inquiry status updates.

steps.description: Login to admin dashboard
Navigate to inquiry management page
Verify list of customer inquiries is displayed with relevant data
Submit a new inquiry via public inquiry form
Confirm new inquiry appears in admin inquiry management page without manual refresh
Update inquiry status and save changes
Verify inquiry status is updated and reflected correctly in the list

title: Performance Optimization: Image Lazy Loading and Layout Stability
description: Ensure all images on public pages use lazy loading correctly and page layout does not shift unexpectedly during content load.

steps.description: Navigate to product listing pages or solutions pages with many images
Monitor that images outside viewport load only when about to scroll into view (lazy loading)
Observe that no significant content layout shifts occur while images load
Navigate to different pages multiple times and verify consistent image loading performance

title: Error Handling: API Failures in CMS and Forms
description: Verify the platform handles backend API errors gracefully for admin CMS actions and public inquiry/support forms with appropriate user feedback.

steps.description: Simulate backend API failure when saving CMS changes in admin
Confirm error messages are shown to admin with no UI crashes and retry options
Simulate API failure when submitting public inquiry form
Verify user sees error feedback and form remains editable for retry

title: Console Error Monitoring During Interactions
description: Ensure there are no console errors or warnings during navigation, data mutations or server interactions on both public and admin sides.

steps.description: Navigate through all main public site pages: homepage, products, solutions, company, support
Verify browser console shows no JavaScript errors or warnings
Login to admin dashboard and perform CMS content changes, product edits, inquiry management
Check console logs for absence of errors or warnings

title: Recent Bug Fix Verification
description: Confirm fixes for hero carousel import, image saving errors, and product material naming consistency are verified and no regressions exist.

steps.description: Load homepage hero carousel and verify images and text display correctly
Verify no import errors occur related to hero carousel
Add or edit a product including image uploads
Ensure image saving completes without errors and product appears correctly
Check product details page for correct and consistent material naming
Confirm that previous naming inconsistencies are resolved
